limits: The two native170/272-coordinate frames are retained, with no additions, removals or reordering.
SIEMENS, FERNSCHREIBER and FERNSPRECHAPPARATE are editorial lexical completions; full source and exact fill/substitution costs are retained.
APPARATE requires both a printed-erasure fill and one observed-coordinate repair at its A; its cost is not described as pure erasure restoration.
The closing punctuation proposal ERBETENX replaces raw ERBETENN at a cost of two observed coordinates. The following KONACH18ROEMX3ANRX11023? label is not expanded or numerically reinterpreted.
The final source-erased symbol is left open over the exact DEQTUX domain. No final separator or reference digit is asserted.
